title: Settings
lead: The parish’s details and how the site behaves. A detail only appears on the public site once approved.
validate_help: Only authorised people can approve. Any change removes the approval.
saved: Saved. The public site updates within about two minutes.
invalid: A field isn’t in the right format. Check the examples.

nameFr.label: Official name (French)
nameFr.help: The name as it should appear on the site.

nameEn.label: Official name (English)
nameEn.help: Leave empty to use the French name.

address.label: Address
address.help: An address people can find on foot or by taxi.

phones.label: Phone number(s)
phones.help: Several numbers: separate them with a comma.

email.label: Email address
email.help: The address the office reads regularly.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp
whatsapp.ph: +237 6XX XX XX XX or channel link
whatsapp.help: A number or a WhatsApp channel link.

facebook.label: Facebook page
facebook.help: The full link, starting with https.

youtube.label: YouTube channel
youtube.help: The full link, starting with https.

mapLat.label: Latitude
mapLat.help: For the map. Copy it from Google Maps (right-click on the church).

moissonsStart.label: Harvest Festival: start
moissonsStart.help: During these dates the site takes on the Harvest Festival colours.

override.label: Force a season
override.help: Rarely needed: the season is computed from the date of Easter.

overrideUntil.label: Until
overrideUntil.help: After this date the automatic calculation resumes.

features.lead: Core features are always on. The others can be switched off: they then disappear from the site and the admin, without deleting anything.
features.confirm_off: Switch off “{name}”? It will disappear from the site and the admin. Nothing is deleted.
features.none: No optional features yet: they come with the next modules.

system.outbox_text: Messages to pass on (resets, invitations) until emails are sent automatically.
system.retention_text: Expired sessions and links removed daily; outbox: 90 days; deleted accounts: 30-day grace; activity log: 24 months.
